groups.title: Poem cards
groups.heading: The poet and the poem, together.
groups.description: A keeps the portrait small and round. B uses a taller artistic portrait. C gives the face more space beside a quieter title. Each keeps the same four-line excerpt area and aligns the reading links.
variants: C · A larger portrait, quieter title
checks: The portrait is on the left; poem title and author are on the right.
All three scripts start their excerpts at the same height in the wide layout.
Overflow ends with an ellipsis; Read the poem opens the complete source text.
Use 360px to inspect long Odia and Hindi lines. No verse is rewritten.
